remote-access.area: public/scripts/comp/mcpActivityClient.js showAgentSessionTrayNotice: the Remote Access tray balloon on #mcpActivityIndicator (desktop and DeX; Melaton Mobile has its own note, 'remote-access-phone') when an agent's MCP key reads, opens or updates this client's session, or reads its location
remote-access.action: a click on the balloon opens the Remote Access log in Periscope (openMcpActivityInPeriscope); right-click on the tray icon unbinds the agent
remote-access.switch: Taskbar and Start Menu Properties > Notification Area > Customize Notifications > Remote Access (trayRegistry popup 'remote-access', trayPopupHidden)
remote-access.note: N1 ok: data she asked for (Yukimi, #1199): who has the machine, by name; a Fleet agent reads Fleet access "<session>" or Fleet access, work item #<id> "<item>", other keys their own name. N3/N9: one balloon per actor and kind, a burst from the same actor within 2 s coalesces (MCP_NOTICE_COALESCE_MS), popupId remote-access replaces the last one. N7: silent (popoverManager plays no sound). On Melaton Mobile (uiShell 'mobile') the same words are the phone note 'remote-access-phone', not this balloon (there is no taskbar there); DeX is the desktop shell and keeps the balloon. Registered in #1199.

remote-access-phone.area: public/scripts/comp/mcpActivityClient.js showAgentSessionTrayNotice (window.uiShell === 'mobile'): the same Remote Access message as one Melaton Mobile notification (wmShell.appNote, title 'Remote Access') when an agent's MCP key reads, opens or updates this client's session, or reads its location
remote-access-phone.action: Disconnect (agent_session_unbind, the tray icon's right-click Disconnect on the desktop) while an agent is bound to this client, else Hide | Dismiss only; the access log (Periscope) is desktop only, so no action opens it
remote-access-phone.switch: Settings > Sounds & Notifications > Notifications > Other notifications > Display message on screen (off: the note waits in the title bar, no bubble; wmShell.js noteDisplays / refreshNotes)
remote-access-phone.note: N1 ok: data she asked for (Yukimi, #1199): who has the machine, by name; a Fleet agent reads Fleet access "<session>" or Fleet access, work item #<id> "<item>", other keys their own name. N7: silent (silent: true; an agent's access is no sound event). N9: one note at a time; a newer notice from the same agent updates it in place (never sounds or pops) while it is up; another agent's access, or any notice after it is gone, closes the old one and makes a new one (that one shows, as the class's Display message on screen says); a burst from the same actor within 2 s still coalesces (MCP_NOTICE_COALESCE_MS). No status bar icon of its own (status-icon-tables: Yukimi decides). Text escaped like the balloon's. The desktop path is 'remote-access'.
